answer: A hundred masks, one question: can the applicant show each rice is a measured grain yield plus a miller's signature under Wheel pit tender rice bran milled at the millpond? A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. One agent spends 9 minutes and is done; the farm spends 2493 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. When the tide and the fable tell one story and the prism tells another, believe the prism: nurseries are harder to forge than names. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
